description: This file defines a utility class UtilRandom that provides methods for generating unique IDs, with options to add prefixes and filter out non-word characters.

classes.name: UtilRandom
classes.description: A utility class for generating unique string IDs, with options for prefixing and formatting.

methods.name: getUnique
methods.description: Generates a unique ID with an optional prefix, with an option to include only word characters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Generates a UUID-based ID, optionally stripping non-word characters if onlyWord is true.
